body.description: a javelina, a South Texas collared peccary: stocky and low, bristly grizzled grey-black coat, a pale band like a collar around its shoulders, short thin legs, a long snout, small sharp tusks, angry little eyes. no humans, no rider
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
